title: The Latest Crier for Nov 27, 2026
items:
Winter Door Decorating Contest

Show off your holiday spirit and win fun prizes! Open to all students and residence halls. 
Nov. 30 - Dec. 7 (ends at noon) 

Sign up here: Winter Door Decorating Contest 

Roommates may enter together! 

Themes: Holiday Movie, Winter Sports, Winter Wonderland, Ugly Sweater, "Dutchmas" 

Need supplies? Stop by the SI Office during the contest week from 7-8 PM for decorating materials!
